title: A clean-up plan from one reopened defect
summary: A portal defect kept getting reopened. I took the developer's root-cause analysis, found the same dead, repeated and tangled code across several portal controllers and proposed a three-phase clean-up to the delivery head.
what_would_have_happened: The team kept patching the same defect each time it reopened, while the same patterns sat in other controllers.
the_call: Fix the root cause in phases, starting in slack time, without putting the release at risk.
what_i_did: Proposed the phases: remove dead code, modularize the controllers, then pull shared logic into one module. I asked the delivery head when phase one could start.
what_changed: The fix went into the next hotfix, and the project manager backed the plan: redesign and refactoring both had to happen.
